title: Lead AI Engineer
description: Lead AI Engineer at Yellow Tech. I design the architecture, the AI writes the code, I review and ship.

sectionDescriptions.projects: Things I built and things I'm building: products, developer tools, AI experiments and a few ideas still on paper.
sectionDescriptions.articles: Articles and notes on architecture, coding agents and how work changes when the AI writes the code.
sectionDescriptions.method: How I work with coding agents: architecture before code, context as the work, measuring instead of trusting.
sectionDescriptions.now: What I'm working on right now, updated from the projects.
sectionDescriptions.about: Who I am, where I come from and how to reach me.
sectionDescriptions.agent: An agent with real tools that works on my projects and shows how: every call, the tokens and the cost.
sectionDescriptions.privacy: What data the site collects, why, where it goes and how long it stays: cookieless statistics, conversations with the agent, messages to me.
sectionDescriptions.changelog: What changed on the site, release after release: pages, agent, projects. The technical log is in the repository.
